_doc: Rule 8. Deletes go to the vault's .trash/ (Obsidian's 'Move to Obsidian trash', help.obsidian.md: Files and links settings) with the same bytes, and the reply lists the links that resolved to the note (now_broken). Links in .obsidian/ and in .trash/ are not links. Creates on a taken path are refused and leave the file unchanged. Creates onto a name other notes have in other folders succeed and list those notes in same_name (owner's decision); files in .trash/ do not count.
